items.description:
##Today##

Dry and sunny for much of the day, only clouding over in the evening ahead of rain arriving overnight.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

3-6


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 10-15, increasing 15-20 in the evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain overnight. Hill fog later.


##Comments##

Strong winds.


##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain throughout the day. There may be a drier slot during the morning, before rain becomes persistent & heavier during the afternoon. Rain clears later in the evening/overnight.


##Temperature##

20

SW


##Wind##

##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain. Hill fog until later.


##Comments##

Strong winds.
